24. 點 $A$ 及點 $B$ 的坐標分別為 $(2,5)$ 及 $(4,-1)$。設 $P$ 為直角坐標平面上的一動點使得 $AP = BP$。求 $P$ 的軌跡的方程。

A. $x - 3y + 3 = 0$
B. $x - 3y - 7 = 0$
C. $x - 3y + 13 = 0$
D. $3x + y - 11 = 0$
reasoning: The set of points equidistant from A and B is the perpendicular bisector of segment AB. The midpoint of A(2,5) and B(4,-1) is M(3,2). The slope of AB is (-1-5)/(4-2) = -3, so the perpendicular bisector has slope 1/3. Using point-slope form: y - 2 = (1/3)(x - 3) => y = (1/3)x + 1 => 3y = x + 3 => x - 3y + 3 = 0. This matches option A.
